Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Mike James?

Mike James is 51 years old.

Where was Mike James born?

Mike James was born in Copiague, New York.

When was Mike James born?

Mike James was born on June 23, 1975.

How tall is Mike James?

Mike James is 6-2 (188 cm) tall.

How much did Mike James weigh when playing?

Mike James weighed 188 lbs (85 kg) when playing.

Is Mike James in the Hall of Fame?

Mike James is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position did Mike James play?

Point Guard.

When did Mike James retire?

Mike James last played in 2014.

What is Mike James' net worth?

Mike James made at least $32,291,974 playing professional basketball.

How much did Mike James make?

Mike James made $6,466,600 in 2010.

What did Mike James average?

Mike James averaged 9.9 points, 2.2 rebounds, and 3.5 assists per game.

How many rings does Mike James have?

Mike James won one championship.

What schools did Mike James attend?

Mike James attended Amityville Memorial in Amityville, New York and Duquesne.

What are Mike James' nicknames?

Pit Bull, The Amityville Horror are nicknames for Mike James.
